exposure: Presence vs. absence of genotype anomalies
outcome: Association between abnormal amniotic fluid and ToF with altered genotype
Association between cesarean delivery and neonatal procedures
cohort: 39 neonates with Tetralogy of Fallot (ToF) born between August 1, 2008, and August 31, 2018, and admitted to a level III neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: An abnormal amount of amniotic fluid is an independent predictive factor for ToF with genotype alterations.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with neonatal procedures (p = 0.006).
